title: Channel Loyalty Points Validation
summary: Check loyalty points earned by retailers, painters, plumbers, mechanics and farmers against real sales and scan data, and catch abnormal scanning before points are paid out.

seo.title: Channel Loyalty Points Validation | VipraTech
seo.description: Validate loyalty points for retailers, painters, plumbers, mechanics and farmers against sales and scan data, and flag abnormal scanning before payout.

problem.intro: Paints, pipes, adhesives, lubricants, auto parts and agri-input brands run loyalty programmes for the people who choose their products: painters, plumbers, carpenters, mechanics, retailers and farmers. Points are earned by scanning codes on packs or by reported purchases, then redeemed for cash or gifts. Points paid for scans that do not reflect real sales are pure cost.

pain_points.title: Codes scanned in bulk
pain_points.detail: Codes collected from packs in warehouses or shops are scanned by a few accounts, far beyond what one person could use.

pain_points.title: Scans that do not match sales
pain_points.detail: Points earned in a town exceed what the brand sold into that town.

pain_points.title: Duplicate and shared accounts
pain_points.detail: One person runs several accounts, or several people share one, to cross slabs.

pain_points.title: Redemptions paid without checks
pain_points.detail: Cash redemptions are paid weekly or monthly with little review.

solution.overview: VipraTech compares loyalty activity with your own sales and the programme's rules. Scans are checked against secondary sales into each town and retailer, and accounts with abnormal patterns, such as bulk scans, scans far from the member's location or accounts sharing devices or bank details, are flagged before redemption. Points that pass are released; the rest go to the programme team with the evidence.
capabilities: Compares scans and points with secondary sales by town and retailer
Flags bulk, odd-hour and far-from-home scanning
Finds linked accounts sharing devices, phones or bank details
Applies programme rules and slabs before redemption
Review queue with each account's activity and evidence
Programme cost and leakage report by region

workflow.title: Load activity
workflow.detail: Scans, points and redemption requests are taken from the loyalty platform.

workflow.title: Load sales
workflow.detail: Secondary sales by town and retailer are taken from the DMS.

workflow.title: Check patterns
workflow.detail: Accounts are checked for bulk scanning, location mismatches and linked accounts.

workflow.title: Compare with sales
workflow.detail: Points earned are compared with what was sold into each town and retailer.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: The programme team reviews flagged accounts with the evidence.

workflow.title: Release
workflow.detail: Redemptions that pass are released, and the rest are held or reversed.

inputs: Member profiles, devices and bank details
Secondary sales by town and retailer
outputs: Accounts flagged for abnormal scanning or linking
Points compared with sales by town
Redemptions released or held, with reasons
Programme cost and leakage by region
human_in_the_loop: The programme team decides on every flagged account, and members can be asked for evidence before points are reversed. The system holds redemptions for review; it does not block members on its own.
guardrails: No member blocked without a person's review
Every flag shows the activity behind it
Personal data used only for programme checks
compliance_notes: Member phone numbers and bank details are personal data under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act; the checks use them only to run the programme, with access limited to the programme team.

pilot.scope: Three months of scans and redemptions for one region, compared with secondary sales for the same period.
deliverables: Scan pattern and linked account checks

what_we_measure.how: Accounts flagged and confirmed by the programme team.
Value of points held or reversed after review.
Time to review a redemption cycle, compared with today.

faqs.q: Our loyalty platform is run by a vendor. Can this work alongside it?
faqs.a: Yes. It works from the vendor's exports or API and returns a list of redemptions to hold or release.
No member is blocked automatically. Flagged accounts go to your team with the evidence, and you decide.
It uses location where the scan records it. Without location, it relies on volumes, timing, linked accounts and the sales comparison.
Distributor claims settlement is live today. Channel loyalty points validation is in early access: we are building it with a small number of brands as design partners.
